items.text: That sounds like a lot of fun! Thanks for the suggestions. I think I'll try out the Paloma and the Tequila Sour during my class on Friday. I've been wanting to experiment with grapefruit juice in cocktails, and the Paloma sounds like a great opportunity to do so. And the Tequila Sour sounds like a unique twist on the classic margarita.
items.why: User specifies trying Paloma and Tequila Sour during their class on Friday (reinforces the day-of-week).

items.text: I like the sound of the Watermelon Basil Margarita. I've been experimenting with basil in my cocktails lately and I think it pairs well with tequila. Do you have any recommendations for a good watermelon puree recipe?
I think I'll try roasting the watermelon to bring out the sweetness. By the way, do you have any recommendations for a good tequila to pair with the watermelon and basil flavors?
I think I'll go with Avion Silver, I've had it before and it's one of my favorites. I've been using it in my homemade margaritas and it always turns out great.
